Definition: a water-ox, i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile-horse
BiblicalUsage: Behemoth carries the plain sense of a great beast, Behemoth, and it shows up only once, in Job 40:15.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Behemoth is a small window into a bigger truth, and I am glad it is there.
